text:
Here comes the time to release doves
in the middle of statue-filled squares.
Our hour is about to strike. At any moment
the bells will ring.

Look at the tender buds of the trees
becoming visible in the newly opened light.
Light ribbons hang from cloud
to cloud. And garlands

across the breast of the sky, pulsing,
are like the breath of a voice. Words
will soon be spoken. Listen. You can hear
the sound of footsteps and the beating of wings.

translation.title: Song for That Day
